title: Perfect
text: Perfect. Okay... if you have not ever owned a GF grill, you should.  I own several and purchased them for many.  This one is for a friend who is working out of hotel room for months and months at a time... he has a "sort of" wet bar area but no oven.  He has a microwave, a deep bar sink and small refridgerator.  The GF allows him to grill a couple of burger patties... grill a toasted cheese.. frozen chicken breasts... etc.  It is AWESOME.  Clearly this is small, one or two person grill. EASY to use... EASY to clean.  It is literally PERFECT for this use.  LOVE my GF grills!!  If you haven't owned one, this is a perfect way to try it.  The price is good and the options for use are numerous!

product_metadata.title: George Foreman 2-Serving Classic Plate Electric Indoor Grill and Panini Press, Black, GRS040B
features: 2 Servings - Tight on countertop space? This grill is your answer. It fits two servings of your grilled favorites, and it’s perfect for small apartments and couples.
New Space-Saving Design* - With a low profile and vertical storage capabilities, it’s simple to fit the grill in small spaces on your countertop or in the cupboard.
Advanced George Tough Nonstick Coating - There’s a lot to love about this nonstick coating. It’s 3x more durable**, easy to clean, and removes the need for butter and oil.
Adjustable Grilling Angle - Set the grill at an angle to remove excess fat during grilling, or put it flat for panini and other toasting tasks. The hinged grill legs are simple to adjust.

Exclusive Fat-Removing Slope - It’s the sure sign of a George Foreman Grill. The sloped grilling surface helps remove excess fat for tasty meals and healthy grilling. Perfect for individuals or couples
description: This compact grill just got even better for small kitchens! The George Foreman® 2-Serving Classic Plate Electric Indoor Grill and Panini Press takes up 34% less space*, so you can store it in tight spots on the countertop or in the cupboard. Classic grill plates feature the Advanced George Tough™ nonstick coating that’s easy to clean, is 3x more durable**, and easy to clean. Plus, the adjustable cooking angle lets you tilt to remove excess fat during grilling, and set it flat for toasting panini. Top and bottom grill plates deliver fast grilling and delicious results for steak, burgers, chicken, veggies, and more! What will you make on your George Foreman® Grill? *Up to 34% less space compared to the George Foreman GR10B, based on height**Compared to standard George Tough™ nonstick coating
